knowledge-vault-rs-main/Cargo.toml:
[workspace]
[package]
name = "knowledge-vault"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/knowledge-vault-rs"
authors = ["SuperInstance AI Team"]
description = "Standalone knowledge vault with vector database, embeddings, and RAG"
rust-version = "1.85"

[dependencies]
# Async runtime
tokio = { version = "1.40", features = ["full"] }

# Serialization
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"

# Error handling
anyhow = "1.0"
thiserror = "2.0"

# Logging
tracing = "0.1"

# Async trait
async-trait = "0.1"

# Database (SQLite)
# "bundled": compile SQLite from source so Windows runners (no system
# sqlite3.lib) link successfully. This was the last layer of the windows
# matrix failure, visible only after the fmt/CRLF layer was fixed.
rusqlite = { version = "0.40", features = ["bundled"] }

# IDs
uuid = { version = "1.10", features = ["v4", "serde"] }

# Time
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }

# File watching
notify = "8.2"

# Crypto for content hashing
sha2 = "0.11"
hex = "0.4"

# Text processing
unicode-segmentation = "1.11"

# Regex for pattern matching
regex = "1.11"

# Futures utilities
futures = "0.3"

[dev-dependencies]
tokio-test = "0.4"
tempfile = "3.10"
criterion = "0.8"

[[bench]]
name = "knowledge_bench"
harness = false

[lib]
name = "knowledge_vault"
path = "src/lib.rs"

# NOTE (2026-09-30): the previous [[example]] entries pointed at files that no
# longer exist (examples/basic_usage.rs, examples/file_watching.rs). That stale
# metadata broke `cargo` target resolution on main: every CI run since ~09-22
# failed before compiling a single crate, which also turned every dependabot
# PR red regardless of its content. The declarations below match the five
# example files that actually exist in examples/.

[[example]]
name = "basic"
path = "examples/basic.rs"

[[example]]
name = "chunking"
path = "examples/chunking.rs"

[[example]]
name = "embeddings"
path = "examples/embeddings.rs"

[[example]]
name = "search"
path = "examples/search.rs"

[[example]]
name = "watcher"
path = "examples/watcher.rs"
